The Stallion Gate is a relic from the Ode to Castlevania DLC in Vampire Survivors. It is the first Gate Key that grants access to new areas in the
stage, and can be obtained upon defeating the

The Stallion Gate opens the entrance to the Castle's Gallery and Laboratory and activates the warp gate outside Dracula's Castle, allowing the player to teleport to any unlocked gate. The Stallion Gate's warp gate teleports the player to the room beyond the First Hallway. Additionally, the Stallion Gate also permanently unlocks
Heart Refreshes, allowing them to appear in the Ode to Castlevania stage or while playing as any character from its associated DLC.
